description:
Changes the owner of the filter.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira. However, the user must own the filter or have the *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the filter to update.
parameters.name: id

requestBody.description: The account ID of the new owner of the filter.

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description:
Returned when:

 *  The new owner of the filter owns a filter with the same name.
 *  An attempt is made to change owner of the default filter.

403.description: Returned if the requesting user is not an owner of the filter or does not have *Administer Jira* global permission.

404.description: Returned if the filter or the new owner of the filter is not found.
